Executive overview

This report summarises the Microsoft 365 licence products in this tenant, how many seats each product has and how many are assigned, and when each subscription's current term ends. The figures come from the most recent data collection for this tenant, not from the moment the report was generated.

Seat totals count licence assignments, so one person holding two products uses two seats. Spare seats are not automatically refundable: seat reductions generally take effect at a subscription's renewal. Talk to Netier before changing seats, plans or terms.
